## About the event

**Your data powers AI today** - should it also power someone else's business tomorrow? Valid question.

  

Join us for the first **French Tech AI Workshop** in Bangkok, led by **Laetitia Hoquetis** & **Maxime Carpentier**, La French Tech Bangkok board members and AI & Data experts.

  

An intimate evening at [**Public House Bangkok**](https://publichouse-hotels.com/creative-space/), a stylish venue with easy access from Sukhumvit, this intimate session is designed for participants already using AI tools such as **ChatGPT, Claude,** or **Copilot** at work, but who have never run an AI model directly **on their own laptop**. Expect concrete use cases, live demonstrations, and hands-on exercises. 👍Spaces are intentionally limited to 25 to encourage discussion and interaction.

  

[Food](http://interaction.Food) and beverages will be available at participants' discretion and payable directly to **Public House Bangkok**.

summary: The gaming industry is booming — and we’re bringing together an incredible lineup of speakers from the French delegation for another inspiring panel discussion.
bodyMd:
## About the event

🎮 The future of gaming is being written right here in Asia — and Bangkok is set to play a key role.

  

On the occasion of **Gamescom Asia 2025**, we’re excited to host the panel **“Beyond Play: How Tech Shapes the Future of Gaming”**, bringing together a delegation of French entrepreneurs and startups to meet Thailand’s vibrant gaming community.  

Thailand’s gaming market is on track to **nearly double by 2030**. This momentum makes the country one of the region’s most exciting playgrounds for developers, creators, and investors. By connecting French innovation with Thailand’s growth, we aim to spark new ideas, collaborations, and opportunities for the industry.  

🙏 Huge thanks to the **Ambassade de France en Thaïlande**, **Business France**, and **Institut Français** for their incredible cooperation and support. ✨

bodyMd:
## About the event

Will AI replace lawyers? ⚖️🤖

  

Every entrepreneur has had the same thought at least once. Lawyers are essential. They protect the business, structure the deals, and keep you out of trouble. But they are also one of the line items you'd love to cut from the budget, right next to rent and software subscriptions.

  

La French Tech Bangkok is delighted to host a practical talks on Legal AI, to answer the question every entrepreneur is quietly asking: how much of my legal spend can I now replace with AI?

  

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗴𝗼𝗼𝗱 𝗻𝗲𝘄𝘀: AI is reshaping legal on both sides at the same time.

  

On the client side, anyone with the right prompts can now draft a complex contract, run a first pass on a due diligence, or get a precise answer on a regulation.

title: Twin Transformation: Why are we treating digital & sustainability as two separate challenges?
address: Unit G101, Ground Floor, The Offices At Central World 999/9 Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Phatumwan Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand
summary: La French Tech Bangkok is delighted to welcome three experts to discuss the Twin Transformation — the convergence of digital innovation and sustainability to drive performance and long-term impact.
bodyMd:
## About the event

Join us on **Thursday, 26 February 2026, from 6:00 PM** at **Common Ground Central World**.  

**La French Tech Bangkok** is pleased to host an evening discussion bringing together industry panelists to explore transformation, disruption, and resilience in today’s fast-moving environment.  

Led by an outstanding duo — **Malika Ait El Mouden** and **Dr.** **Rata Jacquemart**, Board Members of **La French Tech Bangkok** — the conversation will share diverse perspectives from across the ecosystem, highlighting what leaders and organizations must prioritize to navigate change and build long-term impact.
